detail: Full summary: MECHANISM for the Stop hook false positive, refining the earlier finding. This turn made ZERO file edits (read-only Bash and grep only) and the working tree is clean, yet the Stop hook demanded a record. A background workflow's subagents were writing scratch files to /tmp at the time. The PostToolUse activity marker fires on the Edit/Write TOOL CALL, not on whether the written path is inside the project — so a subagent writing anywhere on disk, including outside the repo entirely, trips the controlling session's gate. Fix would be to test the resolved path against the project root before marking activity.
